answer_1.quote: We transform open-domain question answering (QA) into a reading comprehension task to meet the RAG settings. Formally, given the objective f of an open domain question answering task is f : {x} → y, we can formulate the objective of the reading comprehension task as f : {c golden , x} → y.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to open-domain questions based on retrieved contexts and the input query.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the effectiveness of our method using two metrics: exact match (EM) and F1 score.
